newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-PEREC TO ATTEMPT UNPRECEDENTED DOUBLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PEREC TO ATTEMPT UNPRECEDENTED DOUBLE.

text.p: France's double Olympic champion Marie-Jose Perec will attempt an unprecedented 400 metres and 400 metres hurdles double at the Athens world championships this August.
"I will attempt to double 400 metres and 400 metres hurdles at the world championships in Athens," she told the sports daily l'Equipe in an interview published on Wednesday.
Perec, who won the 400 and 200 metres in Atlanta last year, criticised the championships schedule, complaining that she would have to run two qualifying rounds of the 400 metres on the same day.
"I've never seen anything like that before. It will be a real pain in the neck especially as we will have to run the semifinals the next day," she said.
